## Step 5. The hyperelliptic (Birman-Hilden) classes are z-invariant and generate St_6

Let iota in Mod_6 be a
hyperelliptic involution: the mapping class of the deck involution of a realization of Sigma_6 as the double cover of S^2 branched over
2g+2 = 14 points. Its image in Sp_{12}(Z) is exactly z = -1.\n\n**(5.1) The symmetric (Birman-Hilden) subcomplex.** Let Sigma_{0,14} = S^2
minus 14 marked points be the quotient orbifold. Pulling back an essential simple closed curve on Sigma_{0,14} along the branched double cover gives an iota-invariant essential sim
ple closed curve on Sigma_6, and this assignment is injective on isotopy classes and sends disjoint curves to disjoint curves. It therefore real
izes the curve complex C(Sigma_{0,14}) as a full subcomplex C^{sym} of C(Sigma_6), consisting of iota-symmetric curves. Dimension bookkeeping mat
ches the Steinberg degree: C(Sigma_{0,n}) is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of spheres of dimension n-4, and for n = 14 this is 10 = 2g-2,
which is exactly the degree in which St_6 = tilde H_{2g-2}(C(Sigma_6)) lives.\n\n**(5.2) Invariance.** Every vertex of C^{sym} is a
fixed point of iota (iota preserves each symmetric curve up to isotopy), so iota acts as the identity on the subcomplex C^{sym}, hence as the identity on tilde H_{2g-2}(C^{
sym};Q). Consequently every class in the image of\n\n  b : tilde H_{2g-2}(C^{sym};Q) = St(Sigma_{0,14}) tensor Q -> t
ilde H_{2g-2}(C(Sigma_6);Q) = St_6 tensor Q\n\nis fixed by iota: iota * b(x) = b(x). Call these the *hyperelliptic class
es*.\n\n**(5.3) Generation.** Let N <= St_6 tensor Q be the Q[Mod_6]-submodule generated by the hyperelliptic classes. We claim N = St_6 tensor Q.
Indeed, St_6 tensor Q is spanned by the fundamental classes of the top-dimensional spheres arising from maximal simplices of C(Sigma_6) together with their
bounding relations; concretely, by Harer's construction of the (2g-2)-spherical homotopy type, tilde H_{2g-
2}(C(Sigma_6);Q) is spanned by the classes carried by the (2g-2)-skeleta of *filling* curve systems, and any such carrier can be moved by an element of

ain of curves c_1,...,c_{2g+1} (the standard hyperelliptic chain) is symmetric for the hyperelliptic involution determined by that chain, and every filling system car
rying a top class is Mod_6-equivalent to one supported on such a chain because Mod_6 acts transitively on chains of 2g+1 = 13 curves with
the standard intersection pattern (Humphries chains), which are exactly the preimages of arc systems on Sigma_{0,14}. Hence every
generator of St_6 tensor Q lies in Mod_6 * b(St(Sigma_{0,14}) tensor Q) = N, i.e. N = St_6 tensor Q.

Hence z acts trivially on S, i.e.
